# Adam

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P48](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0048)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P48](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0048)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND P19](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Adam is handsome with a coat as white as snow. He also possesses a beautifully curving white tail.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND P23](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0023)_

## Personality

Adam is a wise rooster who has survived the culling of many others of his kind by Mrs. [Davis](../character/davis.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P11](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0011)_

## Traits

- wise  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P11](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0011)</sub>

## History

Adam was raised from a yellow chick by [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) after a weasel killed all of his siblings. His life came to an end when [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) killed him to serve as dinner for the visiting minister, Mr. [Perry](../character/perry.md). Upon learning of his death, [Faith](../character/faith.md) rushed home in a fit of rage.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P48](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0048), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P0](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII.
